name: Consul
description: Consul is a service networking solution from HashiCorp that enables teams to manage secure network connectivity between services and across multi-cloud environments and runtimes. It provides service discovery, service mesh, traffic management, and automated network configuration. Key features include a distributed key-value store, health checking, multi-datacenter support, and a web UI for managing services. This container sets up a single Consul server suitable for development and testing purposes.

notes.text: To enable ACL security, run: consul-helper enable-acl
